2609.38473.title: Re-ranking and Late Interaction Drive Retrieval Quality: A Controlled Comparison of RAG Strategies for Scientific Question Answering
2609.38473.paper_summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is now the standard way to ground Large Language Models (LLMs) in external knowledge, yet the design space of retrieval pipelines is large and the trade-offs between variants are not well understood, especially on domain-specific corpora at realistic scale. In this work, we present a controlled comparison of six retrieval strategies for scientific question answering: (i) classic top-k dense retrieval, (ii) LLM-based query rephrasing, (iii) query rephrasing followed by LLM-based reranking, (iv) multi-query fusion via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), (v) an agentic tool-call pipeline in which the generator decides for itself whether to retrieve, and (vi) late-interaction retrieval with ColBERTv2. All six pipelines share the same generator (Meta-Llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), prompt, and evaluation protocol; the five single-vector pipelines additionally share SPECTER2 embeddings and a Chroma vector store; and all six retrieve from the full corpus of 463,971 arXiv papers dated 2024-2025. To support reproducible, large-scale evaluation, we also release a synthetic question dataset of 19,484 problem-statement and methodology questions generated by Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct from a random sample of 10,000 papers across academic domains (query generation succeeded for 9,742 of them), and every strategy is evaluated on this same query set. We describe the architecture and implementation of each pipeline, release the code and the synthetic question dataset, and evaluate each strategy with an LLM-as-a-judge protocol along multiple quality dimensions, together with direct gold-paper retrieval metrics. The result is an open testbed for studying the cost and quality trade-offs of RAG design choices on a research-literature corpus, and a basis for future work on faithfulness, retrieval robustness, and agentic retrieval.
2609.38473.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）現在是將大型語言模型（LLMs）與外部知識相結合的標準方法，但檢索管道的設計空間很大，變體之間的權衡尚未得到充分理解，特別是在現實規模的特定領域語料庫上。在本研究中，我們對六種科學問答的檢索策略進行了受控比較：（i）經典的 top-k 密集檢索，（ii）基於 LLM 的查詢改寫，（iii）查詢改寫後的基於 LLM 的重新排序，（iv）通過互惠排名融合（RRF）的多查詢融合，（v）一個代理工具調用管道，其中生成器自行決定是否檢索，以及（vi）使用 ColBERTv2 的晚期互動檢索。這六個管道共享相同的生成器（Meta-Llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）、提示和評估協議；這五個單向量管道還共享 SPECTER2 嵌入和 Chroma 向量存儲；所有六個管道都從 2024-2025 年的 463,971 篇 arXiv 論文的完整語料庫中檢索。為了支持可重複的大規模評估，我們還發布了一個合成問題數據集，其中包含 19,484 個問題陳述和方法論問題，這些問題是由 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 從 10,000 篇跨學術領域的隨機樣本生成的（查詢生成成功地為 9,742 篇），並且每個策略都在這個相同的查詢集上進行評估。我們描述了每個管道的架構和實現，發布了代碼和合成問題數據集，並在多個質量維度上使用 LLM 作為評判者的協議對每個策略進行評估，並結合直接的金標檢索指標。結果是一個開放的測試平台，用於研究 RAG 設計選擇在研究文獻語料庫上的成本和質量權衡，並為未來在忠實性、檢索穩健性和代理檢索方面的工作奠定基礎。
